prompt: Create an ultra-premium architectural sales poster for a fictional luxury real estate developer, designed as a concept-to-reality hero visual where a finished villa appears to actively grow out of its own architectural drawing. Preserve the exact core composition: a clean white background, a modern residence centered in frontal view, the left side rendered as a fully realized hyper-real built architecture photograph, the right side rendered as an elegant black technical drawing and section-elevation sketch, with a realistic hand holding a black pen in the lower-right foreground. The entire image must feel like a world-class developer launch campaign, an architect’s design statement, and a collectible premium sales poster at the same time. The most important visual force is the transition energy from left to right: the real built architecture must appear to extend, dissolve, and transform into drafting lines, as if the building is actively emerging from the blueprint. Strengthen this transformation so the slab edges, glazing lines, roof plane, stair geometry, structural grid, and interior partitions all flow progressively from fully built form on the left into semi-material linework and then into pure architectural drawing on the right. The transition must feel elegant, deliberate, and fluid, never abrupt or collage-like. It should look as though the villa is being born from the architect’s pen and technical intelligence. The building itself is the absolute visual protagonist: a refined two-story contemporary villa with crisp white volumes, floor-to-ceiling low-iron glass, thin black or dark bronze framing, warm timber soffits, calm horizontal slabs, and a stepped landscape plinth. The left built side must feel highly desirable and fully real, with luminous glazing, soft warm interiors, pale plaster or stone walls, elegant furniture silhouettes, subtle reflections, restrained landscaping, and a few trees placed to support the composition. The architecture must remain believable, buildable, luxurious, and globally premium. On the right side, depict the same house as a precise architectural drawing using premium black technical linework: section cuts, elevation lines, dimensional strings, structural notation, staircase indications, interior outlines, construction guides, and delicate drafting hierarchy. The linework must be rigorous but beautiful, standardized yet poetic, with enough information to feel like a real architect’s presentation, but kept clean and elegant. The drawing density should gradually increase toward the far right while remaining airy and highly legible. Place a realistic adult hand in the lower-right foreground holding a black pen, naturally aligned with the drawing process. The hand must be anatomically correct and secondary to the architecture, but it should reinforce the idea that design is actively generating reality. Fingers must have correct proportions, realistic joints, believable skin texture, natural grip tension, and no deformation. The pen tip should connect organically to the drafted line system. Push the Transit direction strongly: simplify all graphic noise, reduce annotation clutter, enlarge negative space, refine alignment, and make the entire image feel more international, more luxurious, more editorial, and more controlled. Push the Port direction strongly: compress the full visual memory into three dominant symbols only, the left real villa, the right technical drawing, and the drawing hand in the lower-right. Everything else must stay subordinate. The image should feel cleaner, sharper, and more brand-defining than a typical architecture board. Lighting should be soft, premium, and controlled. The left built architecture should be washed in bright elegant daylight with gentle shadow depth and warm interior glow visible through the glass. The right drawing side should remain lighter, flatter, and more graphic, but still physically coherent within the same visual world. Increase the tonal separation between real architecture and drawing just enough to heighten the transformation effect. Keep the whole page airy, luminous, and free of heavy black masses. Graphic language must be extremely clean and high-end: large negative space, thin black drafting lines, refined micro-annotation marks, minimal fictional English project title and discreet developer logo, and elegant editorial spacing. Use only original invented English naming. Typography must be sparse, luxurious, and secondary to the architectural image. The poster should feel like a flagship launch ad for a signature villa product. Material rendering must be exceptionally refined: matte white walls, clear low-iron glass, warm natural wood soffits, pale stone terraces, precise mullions, subtle landscape textures, soft ground shadow, crisp white presentation surface, and premium black ink drafting lines. The overall fusion of built architecture and design representation must feel seamless, intelligent, and immediately striking. Color system: dominant white and soft warm gray, black technical lines, pale greenery, amber timber warmth, soft golden interior glow, and minimal neutral landscape tones. Keep saturation restrained, premium, and globally architectural. No copied project names, no real company names, no Chinese headline, no cluttered annotations, no messy sketch lines, no abrupt split between photo and drawing, no distorted perspective, no fantasy structure, no extra buildings, no muddy shadows, no black blotches, no watermark, no existing brand logos, no malformed hands, no extra fingers, no broken finger anatomy.

promptZh: 为一家虚构的豪华房地产开发商创作一张超高端建筑销售海报，设计为“从概念到现实”的英雄视觉图，呈现一座成品别墅仿佛正从其建筑图纸中生长出来的效果。保持核心构图：干净的白色背景，现代住宅居中正面视图；左侧渲染为完全实现的超写实建筑摄影，右侧渲染为优雅的黑色技术图纸和剖面立面草图，右下角前景处有一只手握着黑色钢笔。整张图片必须同时具备世界级开发商发布活动的质感、建筑师的设计宣言以及极具收藏价值的高端销售海报风格。最重要的视觉张力在于从左到右的过渡能量：真实的建筑必须看起来在延伸、消融并转化为绘图线条，仿佛建筑正从蓝图中破茧而出。强化这种转化，使楼板边缘、玻璃线条、屋顶平面、楼梯几何结构、结构网格和室内隔断都从左侧的完全建成形态，平滑过渡到半材质线条，最终演变为右侧纯粹的建筑图纸。过渡必须优雅、刻意且流畅，绝不能突兀或像拼贴画。它应该看起来像是别墅正从建筑师的笔尖和技术智慧中诞生。建筑本身是绝对的视觉主角：一座精致的双层现代别墅，拥有清爽的白色体块、落地低铁玻璃、纤细的黑色或深青铜色框架、温暖的木质吊顶、沉稳的水平楼板以及阶梯状的景观基座。左侧的建成部分必须显得极具吸引力且真实，配以明亮的玻璃、柔和温暖的室内光、浅色灰泥或石墙、优雅的家具轮廓、微妙的反射、克制的景观以及几棵用于支撑构图的树木。建筑必须保持可信、可建造、豪华且具有全球高端品质。在右侧，用优质的黑色技术线条描绘同一座房子：剖面切割、立面线条、尺寸标注、结构注释、楼梯指示、室内轮廓、施工导线以及精致的绘图层级。线条必须严谨而优美，标准化且富有诗意，包含足够的信息以呈现真实建筑师的方案，同时保持简洁优雅。绘图密度应向最右侧逐渐增加，同时保持通透和高度可读性。在右下角前景处放置一只写实的成年人的手，握着黑色钢笔，与绘图过程自然对齐。手部必须解剖学正确，作为建筑的辅助元素，但应强化“设计正在创造现实”的理念。手指比例必须正确，关节写实，皮肤纹理可信，握笔张力自然，无畸形。笔尖应与绘图线条系统有机连接。强烈推动过渡方向：简化所有图形噪点，减少注释杂乱，扩大留白，优化对齐，使整张图片感觉更国际化、更豪华、更具编辑感和掌控力。强烈推动项目方向：将完整的视觉记忆压缩为三个主要符号：左侧真实别墅、右侧技术图纸和右下角的绘图手。其他一切必须保持从属地位。图片应比典型的建筑项目更干净、更锐利、更具品牌定义感。光线应柔和、高级且可控。左侧建成建筑应沐浴在明亮优雅的日光中，带有柔和的阴影深度，透过玻璃可见温暖的室内光。右侧绘图部分应保持更亮、更平坦、更具图形感，但在同一视觉世界中保持物理连贯。增加真实建筑与图纸之间的色调分离，以增强转化效果。保持整个页面通透、明亮，避免沉重的黑色块。图形语言必须极其干净且高端：大面积留白、纤细的黑色绘图线条、精致的微型注释标记、极简的虚构英文项目标题和低调的开发商标志，以及优雅的排版间距。仅使用原创的虚构英文命名。排版必须稀疏、奢华，并从属于建筑图像。海报应感觉像是旗舰别墅产品的发布广告。材质渲染必须极其精致：哑光白墙、透明低铁玻璃、温暖的天然木吊顶、浅色石材露台、精准的竖框、微妙的景观纹理、柔和的地面阴影、清爽的白色展示表面以及优质的黑色墨水绘图线条。建成建筑与设计表现的整体融合必须感觉无缝、智能且令人印象深刻。色彩系统：以白色和柔和暖灰色为主，辅以黑色技术线条、浅绿色、琥珀色木材暖色、柔和的金色室内光以及极简的中性景观色调。保持饱和度克制、高级且具有全球建筑风格。禁止复制项目名称、禁止使用真实公司名称、禁止中文标题、禁止杂乱的注释、禁止凌乱的草图线条、禁止照片与图纸之间的突兀分割、禁止扭曲的透视、禁止幻想结构、禁止额外的建筑物、禁止浑浊的阴影、禁止黑色斑点、禁止水印、禁止现有品牌标志、禁止畸形的手、禁止多余的手指、禁止破碎的手部解剖结构。
